text: 此人不能告诉你什么。
source_text: 此人不能告诉你什么。

text: The Raider is too frightened of Garl to speak to you any more.
source_text: The Raider is too frightened of Garl to speak to you any more.

text: 歹徒被伽尔吓坏了以至于再也不和你进一步交谈。
source_text: 歹徒被伽尔吓坏了以至于再也不和你进一步交谈。

text: You see a tough desert Raider.
source_text: You see a tough desert Raider.

text: 你看到一个彪悍的沙漠歹徒。
source_text: 你看到一个彪悍的沙漠歹徒。

text: It's the Death-Hand. He's returned!
source_text: It's the Death-Hand. He's returned!

text: 是死亡之手。他回来了！
source_text: 是死亡之手。他回来了！

text: Excuse me, Death-Hand. I'm sorry to disturb you.
source_text: Excuse me, Death-Hand. I'm sorry to disturb you.

text: 对不起，死亡之手，抱歉打扰你。
source_text: 对不起，死亡之手，抱歉打扰你。

text: Have you come back to kill your son?
source_text: Have you come back to kill your son?

text: 你回来杀你的儿子？
source_text: 你回来杀你的儿子？

text: Aiyeee! A ghost!
source_text: Aiyeee! A ghost!

text: 啊啊啊！一个鬼！
source_text: 啊啊啊！一个鬼！

text: The dead walk again! The Death-Hand has returned!
source_text: The dead walk again! The Death-Hand has returned!

text: 死人再次光临！死亡之手回来了！
source_text: 死人再次光临！死亡之手回来了！

text: Well met.
source_text: Well met.

text: 很高兴见到你。
source_text: 很高兴见到你。

text: Hi.
source_text: Hi.

text: 嘿。
source_text: 嘿。

text: I'm waiting for Garl to crush Shady Sands. I want some loot.
source_text: I'm waiting for Garl to crush Shady Sands. I want some loot.

text: 我等伽尔把沙荫镇打垮后，再去洗劫一番。
source_text: 我等伽尔把沙荫镇打垮后，再去洗劫一番。

text: Welcome friend.
source_text: Welcome friend.

text: 欢迎你朋友。
source_text: 欢迎你朋友。

text: I'm glad that you could return for a visit.
source_text: I'm glad that you could return for a visit.

text: 我很高兴你能回来看看。
source_text: 我很高兴你能回来看看。

text: Unless you want trouble, you'd better put that away.
source_text: Unless you want trouble, you'd better put that away.

text: 除非你想惹麻烦，你最好收起武器。
source_text: 除非你想惹麻烦，你最好收起武器。

text: Do you want to party?
source_text: Do you want to party?

text: 你要参加宴会吗？
source_text: 你要参加宴会吗？

text: Oh, a tough one, huh?
source_text: Oh, a tough one, huh?

text: 哦，一个恶棍，嗯？
source_text: 哦，一个恶棍，嗯？

text: Garl Death-Hand loves his warriors. Put that thing away and go talk to him.
source_text: Garl Death-Hand loves his warriors. Put that thing away and go talk to him.

text: “死亡之手”伽尔喜欢他的战士。收起你的武器和去和他谈谈。
source_text: “死亡之手”伽尔喜欢他的战士。收起你的武器和去和他谈谈。

text: So, you think you're tough, huh? Mess with me and we'll both find out.
source_text: So, you think you're tough, huh? Mess with me and we'll both find out.

text: 你觉得你很壮，嗯？我们比试比试看谁更厉害。
source_text: 你觉得你很壮，嗯？我们比试比试看谁更厉害。

text: I don't like your looks.
source_text: I don't like your looks.

text: 我不喜欢你盯着我。
source_text: 我不喜欢你盯着我。

text: Go away!
source_text: Go away!

text: 滚！
source_text: 滚！

text: What do you want?
source_text: What do you want?

text: 你要干吗？
source_text: 你要干吗？

text: I'm looking for a woman named Tandi. Seen her?
source_text: I'm looking for a woman named Tandi. Seen her?

text: 我正在找一个叫坦蒂的女人。你看见她了吗？
source_text: 我正在找一个叫坦蒂的女人。你看见她了吗？

text: Nothing. Just looking around.
source_text: Nothing. Just looking around.

text: 没事。就是来看看。
source_text: 没事。就是来看看。

text: Huh??
source_text: Huh??

text: Oh. You must be looking for a job. Go and see Garl in the big room and leave us alone.
source_text: Oh. You must be looking for a job. Go and see Garl in the big room and leave us alone.

text: 哦。你必须找个活干干。到大房子里找伽尔去吧。
source_text: 哦。你必须找个活干干。到大房子里找伽尔去吧。

text: Then do it elsewhere.
source_text: Then do it elsewhere.

text: 然后在别的地方也这样干。
source_text: 然后在别的地方也这样干。

text: Nah. I ain't seen her. Why are you asking?
source_text: Nah. I ain't seen her. Why are you asking?

text: 没。我没有看见过她。你为什么这么问？
source_text: 没。我没有看见过她。你为什么这么问？

text: Nothing. Just looking for a friend of mine.
source_text: Nothing. Just looking for a friend of mine.

text: 没事。我仅仅是来找我的一个朋友。
source_text: 没事。我仅仅是来找我的一个朋友。

text: There is a bounty on her head. If I can kill her, I can get some good cash.
source_text: There is a bounty on her head. If I can kill her, I can get some good cash.

text: 她的头可值大价钱。如果我杀了她，我就能拿到很多的钱。
source_text: 她的头可值大价钱。如果我杀了她，我就能拿到很多的钱。

text: You're lying. Where is she?
source_text: You're lying. Where is she?

text: 你在撒谎。她在哪？
source_text: 你在撒谎。她在哪？

text: Ah, ok.
source_text: Ah, ok.

text: 啊，好。
source_text: 啊，好。

text: Really? What does she look like?
source_text: Really? What does she look like?

text: 真的吗？她长什么样子？
source_text: 真的吗？她长什么样子？

text: About 6 feet tall. Blonde. She's from Shady Sands.
source_text: About 6 feet tall. Blonde. She's from Shady Sands.

text: 大概六英尺高。白皮肤。她来自沙荫镇。
source_text: 大概六英尺高。白皮肤。她来自沙荫镇。

text: Yeah, she's here. She's in the big house. You know, if we tell Garl,# then he would want a piece of the bounty. You might want to think about that.
source_text:
Yeah, she's here. She's in the big house. You know, if we tell Garl,
# then he would want a piece of the bounty. You might want to think about that.

text: 是的，她在这里。她在一个大房子里。你知道的，如果我们告诉伽尔，他会给我点甜头，你或许应该考虑考虑这问题。
source_text: 是的，她在这里。她在一个大房子里。你知道的，如果我们告诉伽尔，他会给我点甜头，你或许应该考虑考虑这问题。

text: You don't sound like you mean it. I think that you are up to something.# And if you are telling the truth, then I'll bag the reward for myself.
source_text:
You don't sound like you mean it. I think that you are up to something.
# And if you are telling the truth, then I'll bag the reward for myself.

text: 听上去不是真的。讲讲那些事情。如果你跟我说实话，我就给你一大笔奖励。
source_text: 听上去不是真的。讲讲那些事情。如果你跟我说实话，我就给你一大笔奖励。

text: I . . . I can't say any more, or Garl will kill me.
source_text: I . . . I can't say any more, or Garl will kill me.

text: 我……我不能说太多，不然伽尔会杀了我的。
source_text: 我……我不能说太多，不然伽尔会杀了我的。

text: Bite me!
source_text: Bite me!

text: 干我呀！
source_text: 干我呀！

text: I don't like your looks. You'd better get away from me.
source_text: I don't like your looks. You'd better get away from me.

text: 我不喜欢你这样盯着我。你最好离我远点。
source_text: 我不喜欢你这样盯着我。你最好离我远点。

text: What? Go away!
source_text: What? Go away!

text: 什么？滚！
source_text: 什么？滚！
